sources.title: Eurocircuits RF pool insights and details (fetched 2026-10-05)

capabilities.layer_counts_note: general layer-count range not read; detailed build-ups are only in their online buildup editor
capabilities.impedance_note: defined-impedance pool: 4, 6 or 8 layers, Isola IS400 (pooled) or 370HR (non-pooled), 1.00 mm (4L only) or 1.55 mm; other builds non-pooled through the online calculator

rf.note: RF pool: I-Tera and RO4350 pooled on 2 and 4 layers; RO4003 and 1 / 6-16 layers non-pooled; multilayer prepreg Isola PCL370HR

capabilities.hybrid_note: RF pool build-up options include mixed RF and FR4
